mapper.select: select SUM(o.amount) amount, COUNT(o.status) status, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) avgAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS waitingOrders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS deliveredOrders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 5 THEN 1 END) AS completedOrders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 6 THEN 1 END) AS cancelledOrders from orders o WHERE DATE(o.order_time) = CURDATE();
select id,number,amount,order_time,user_name,status from orders o WHERE order_time >= CURDATE() AND order_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS allOrders, SUM(status = 1) AS waiting, SUM(status = 2) AS confirmed, SUM(status = 3) AS delivering, SUM(status = 4) AS completed, SUM(status = 5) AS cancelled FROM orders;

select o.number orderId, o.status orderStatus, o.user_name userName, o.phone AS phone, o.address AS address, o.amount AS amount, o.tableware_number AS tablewareNumber, o.order_time AS orderTime, o.estimated_delivery_time AS estimatedDeliveryTime, o.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, od.name AS orderDishes, od.dish_flavor AS remark from orders o left join order_detail od on o.id = od.order_id where o.number = #{orderId}
